subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: For an existing Matrix poll with more than 20 answers, should OpenClaw silently retain the first 20 at the event-builder boundary, or fail the send with a clear limit error?
rationale: MSC3381 establishes the 20-answer ceiling, but it does not alone determine whether OpenClaw may discard user-supplied answers instead of surfacing an error; that behavior affects interoperability and existing caller expectations.

options.title: Approve builder-only truncation
options.body: Keep the current builder-boundary slice so oversized polls remain sendable as valid 20-answer Matrix events, accepting that later answers are discarded.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Validate at the Matrix boundary and return a clear error so callers must reduce the option set rather than losing answers silently.

recommendation.title: Approve builder-only truncation
recommendation.body: Keep the current builder-boundary slice so oversized polls remain sendable as valid 20-answer Matrix events, accepting that later answers are discarded.
